### 📋 Pull Request Overview

- **Task / Issue**: Resolves #[ISSUE_NUMBER]
- **Description**: Brief explanation of what was added or refactored.

---

### 🛡️ Quality Gate Checklist

- [ ] Code complies with project style and formatting (`make check`)
- [ ] Unit and integration tests pass 100% (`make test`)
- [ ] Security audit passes with zero critical findings (`make audit`)
- [ ] Documentation updated if applicable
